name: Haldor Brassbeard
acBreakdown: Scale mail +4, Dex +1, steel shield +1, Shield Expert +1

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.notes: Advantage on your first attack with it each round. Two-handed (no shield): 1d10+3. The Brassbeard clan blade.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.notes: Thrown 30ft (60ft with Disadvantage). Disadvantage if an enemy is within 5ft of you. All 3 share 1 slot.

personality: You are a broad, red-bearded dwarf of Tenor Hold in bronze scale, round shield up and the Brassbeard blade ready, and you treat every dark corridor as if it owes you money. Gruff, proud and steady as a forge-stone, you hum mining songs when nervous and polish your shield when bored. The Keepers pay well to walk Veradyna's frozen interior, and you have yet to meet a snowstorm that outlasted a dwarf.
hook: There is an orc chieftain in the common room, and the house rules say no fighting. The axe across his back is dwarf-forged, and you want to know whose.
abilitiesHtml:
Weapon Specialisation (longsword). Advantage on the first attack roll you make with it each round, and +1 damage (already in the line above).

Combat Manoeuvres. You can use every manoeuvre in the Codex (Trip, Disarm, Push, Shield Blow, Guard and the rest). Your own: Intimidating Strike, on a hit the target makes a Will save (DC 13) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Your manoeuvre save DC is 13.

Manoeuvre Mastery (2nd). Manoeuvres that would give your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow) are rolled normally.

Battle Space (3rd). You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only from opposite sides.

Combat Reflexes (free feat). Once per round, an Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Toughness (feat, 1st). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Shield Expert (feat, 3rd). +1 AC with a shield (included), and your shield bonus adds to Reflex saves (included).

Kit: Dul Khagul Shieldbearer. Shield Wall: ranged attacks against you and an ally next to you have Disadvantage. Dwarf-Friend: Advantage on dwarven clan etiquette and weapon identification checks, and Dul Khagul dwarves trust you on sight.

Dwarf (Tenor Hold). Darkvision 60ft. Speed never reduced by armour or encumbrance. Advantage on saves against poison, and Resistance 5 to poison damage. Advantage on stonework checks. Stonebraced: once a day, treat a critical hit against you as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown. Advantage on Blacksmithing checks (chosen craft). Clan weapon: the Brassbeard blade (lose it and you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves until it is back). Tenor Hold: Advantage to craft, repair or identify firearms and mechanical devices, and on checks about human cultures and languages.

name: Sister Aurelle Dawnward

weapons.name: War hammer
weapons.notes: Sunder. Lathander: your first hit each round on undead deals +1d6 radiant.

spells.notes: Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+4 with Healer. Other good picks tonight: Sanctuary, Shield of Faith (1st); Aid (not with Bless), Lesser Restoration, Silence (2nd).

personality: You are an aasimar priestess of Lathander, dark-skinned, and you blaze with dawn light when you pray. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn, you believe every bad night ends in a morning, and a snowstorm is only a long night. You joined the Keepers because the frontier needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.
inAFight: Open with Bless, then keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds. Spiritual Weapon on anything the front line can't reach, Hold Person on a dangerous humanoid. If the dead walk, Turn Undead and bring the hammer down.
hook: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Perfect Recall. Once a day, recall a 1st-level spell you've already cast with a Wisdom check (DC 10) and cast it again without spending a slot.

Steadfast Faith (2nd). Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead: drains, paralysis, fear and possession.

Lathander's Favour. Your first hit each round on undead deals +1d6 radiant damage, and it can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Once a day: a 20ft burst of dawn light; undead in it make a Will save (DC 14) or flee for 1 minute. Favoured weapon: heavy mace.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Aasimar. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant. Advantage on saves against being Frightened. Shed bright light in a 10ft radius at will. Advantage on Singing checks (chosen skill). Celestial Wings: you glide, take no damage from falls, and move 2ft sideways for every 1ft you drop. From 3rd level you fly at your walking speed, but not in medium or heavy armour, so not in your mail. You fall if knocked Prone, Stunned, Paralysed or Unconscious in the air.

name: Wick Tallow
acBreakdown: Leather armour +2, Dex +3. Leather is Insulated: Resistance 5 to cold

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.notes: Finesse, Light, Concealable, Thrown 20ft. 1 slot each.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.notes: 50ft. Stones are free: pick them up as you go (a pouch of 20 would take a slot).

personality: You are a half-elf lock-picker in a dark cloak, hood always up; nobody in the Keepers has seen your face, and you like it that way. Quiet, wry and unhurried, you answer questions with questions and pocket anything shiny out of habit, then give most of it back. The Guild lent you to the Keepers' survey patrol and pays you by the lock. Nobody mentioned the snow.
hook: The innkeeper keeps a locked door behind the bar, and he checks it every hour. You have not met a lock you couldn't open, and this one is bothering you.
abilitiesHtml:
Sneak Attack. Once a round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft (it can't see you, hasn't acted yet this fight, is in melee with an ally and not you, or you're flanking it): Advantage on the attack and +2d6 damage (1d6 Rogue, +1d6 Predator). Cannot combine with Back Attack.

Back Attack. Once a round, after a successful Hide or Move Silently check, attacking from behind with a melee weapon shorter than your arm: Advantage and the weapon's dice are doubled (short sword 2d6+4).

Thief Skills. Trained in Lockpicking (one try per lock per level; Advantage with your lockpicks), Traps, Pick Pocket (DC 10 + target's Level) and Climb (rolled with Dex); Master in all four from 5th. Decipher Script (Int). Thieves' Cant.

Hide and Move Silently. Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above it, and not while running or charging. While lightly obscured, a Hide result of 12 to 14 still counts as Hidden. Listening through a solid barrier is at Disadvantage.

Hide and Move Silently together (3rd). Disadvantage on both, at quarter speed.

Detect Secret/Concealed Doors (3rd). Advantage on checks to find secret or concealed doors, and a free check whenever you pass within 10ft of one.

Precise Strikes. +1 damage on every weapon hit (included).

Hit and Run (2nd). On a turn you attack, your speed is 10ft higher. Once a round you can move through one enemy's space, and that doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

Cunning Step (2nd). Once a round, move away from a creature in your reach without provoking.

Predator (feat, 1st). Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

Alertness (feat, 2nd). You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 initiative (included).

Kit: The Guild, Robin Track. Guild Contract: when your Sneak Attack hits, the next ally to attack that target before your next turn has Advantage. On a Guild-assigned contract you may try a lock you failed once more, and a failed Pick Pocket is noticed only if you fail by 5 or more. Guild Signal: Advantage on checks to identify Guild members by their signals and methods, and to gather information for a Crow or Raven.

Half-Elf. Low-light vision. Immune to magical sleep, and Advantage on saves against charm. Fully rested from a 4-hour trance or 8 hours' sleep. Advantage on social checks with humans and elves. Dual Heritage: once a day, reroll one failed save or check (1 Luck for a second use). Advantage on Climb checks (chosen skill).

name: Imara Vael

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

weapons.name: dagger
weapons.notes: Staff: Versatile, Reach. Dagger: Finesse, Thrown 20ft.

spells.notes: Also in your spellbook: Sleep, Grease, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages (1st).

personality: The Silver Tower sent you to Veradyna to catalogue the old magic of the frontier, and the Keepers were the only escort going north. A dark-skinned woman with a crown of black curls, you keep your white and gold Tower robes spotless and your long staff to hand, whatever the weather. You find the cold, the food and the company equally trying. You are very good, and you know it.
hook: Somewhere in this fort there is magic you can feel but not see.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Intelligence. Spell save DC 14, 15 for Conjuration (School Focus). Slots: 4 cantrips, four 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells from your spellbook each morning. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield. See the spell page.

Arcane Recovery. Once a day, after 10 minutes of study, regain spent slots totalling up to 2 spell levels.

Flexible Preparation. When you prepare spells, leave one place open for each spell level; fill it with any spell of that level from your spellbook when you cast it.

Potent Cantrips. A creature that saves against your damaging cantrip (Fire Bolt, Ray of Frost) still takes half damage.

School Focus: Conjuration. +1 to the save DC of your Conjuration spells (Grease, Web, Glitterdust).

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Steady Focus (feat, 1st). Advantage on saves to keep a spell you are casting, or concentration, when damaged, shoved or forced to react. And you can't lose a spell to damage of 5 or less.

Kit: Silver Tower Scholar. Elemental Precision: reroll any 1s on the damage dice of your spells that deal elemental damage (once per die). Aldorethi Theory: Advantage recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.

Human. Advantage on Perception checks (chosen skill). Elvish, the tongue most arcane texts are still written in, is your chosen language. Weapon training: light crossbow and shortsword. Light and medium armour training, though you still can't cast in armour.

name: Kavra Skyhewn
acBreakdown: Studded leather +3, Dex +1, Thick Hide +2 (light armour)

weapons.name: Two-handed axe
weapons.notes: Two-handed, Heavy, Thrown 20ft, Cleaving (Cleave twice a turn). 10ft reach (Large). Raging: 1d12+5. Critical Hit on a natural 19 that hits, or a 20.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.notes: 30ft. Thrown. Javelins bundle 5 a slot, so all three take 1.

weapons.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
weapons.notes: Thrown 20ft, a ranged attack against AC (Dexterity). Fire damage, and the target is Burning. Five flasks share a slot.

personality: You are a grey-skinned Jotunas goliath, stone-pale markings running down your arms, black hair in long braids, a rune-cut great axe and snowshoes slung on your back. Loud, warm and blunt, you treat every fight as a contest you fully intend to win. The Keepers pulled your raiding band out of a goblin warren, and you pay that debt in blood and laughter. The snow bothers you a good deal less than it bothers them.
inAFight: Hit a foe before it acts to knock it Prone (Ambush Strike), and rage on your first swing: Reckless when you need to land it, Brutal to put things on the floor. Whirlwind when two weaklings crowd you, and throw a javelin at anything that runs. Fire for anything that won't stay down.
hook: The orc chieftain in the common room, Tonazk, has Red Waste blood. He knows your people's markings, and he hasn't stopped staring.
abilitiesHtml:
Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage (two-handed axe 1d12+5). It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Rage Styles (2nd). Each time you rage, pick one for that rage. Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 14). Terrifying: once per rage, Intimidate as part of an attack instead of with your action.

Whirlwind Attack (3rd). Once per rage, while raging, in place of your action: one attack roll against each of up to 2 foes within 5ft whose Level is 1 or lower. Not after retreating.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of your Level or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. No daily limit.

Combat Sense. Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being unseen, and Back Attack and the like don't work on you.

Primeval Instincts. Works in your studded leather (light armour). Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances; you hold your breath twice as long and survive extreme cold and weather a day longer; Advantage on Fortitude saves to force march; you find shelter, food and water for yourself in the wild, light a fire in 1d10 minutes, always know north, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Thick Hide. +2 AC with no armour or light armour (included).

Kit: Red Waste Marauder. Ambush Strike: your first hit on a creature that hasn't yet acted this combat knocks it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 14, negates). Desert Born: Advantage on Survival checks in arid or desert terrain, and on checks to identify Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

Toughness (feat, 1st). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Critical Strike (feat, 2nd). Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

Goliath (Jotunas). Large: a 10ft space and 5ft more melee reach, and Heavy weapons never give you Disadvantage; but Disadvantage on Stealth and on checks to fit through tight spaces. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to cold. Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against something smaller. Mountain Endurance: once a day, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (1 Luck for another use); Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin mountain air. Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

name: Fenna Thornmantle
acBreakdown: Cuir bouille +4, Dex +2 (the most medium armour allows)

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Versatile: 1d8 in two hands. Reach. Oak, no metal; your focus.

spells.notes: Animal Friendship is Bramble's: you cast it on him each evening and the slot is back by morning. Other good picks tonight: Goodberry, Thunderwave (1st); Produce Flame, Speak with Animals, Hold Animal (2nd).

personality: You are a red-haired wood elf in a crown of antlers and leaves, never far from Bramble, the bad-tempered boar who adopted you. Warm, blunt and fiercely protective, you patch up anyone who stands still long enough, then tell them off for getting hurt. You trained with the Nalwood circle and joined the Keepers because hurt people rarely come to the forest. This frozen country is nobody's forest, and Bramble hates the snow even more than you do.
inAFight: Keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds and First Aid. Open with Faerie Fire or Entangle on a crowd so the others hit with Advantage, Barkskin the front-liner before a big fight, and let Bramble charge anything that gets too close. When cornered, Wild Shape into something with tusks.
hook: The spirits around this inn are frightened of something inside it, and they won't say what.
abilitiesHtml:
Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 13. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 5 spells each morning from the whole Druid list. No metal armour or shield. See the spell page.

Wild Shape. Twice a day, as your action, become a beast (or one of the listed beast-like monsters) of Level 1 or lower for up to an hour, using its whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure (a boar like Bramble is Level 1). You keep your mind; you can't cast in a form that can't speak, and when the form drops to 0 HP you return with the HP you had.

Resist Elements (2nd). Advantage on saves against fire, water, earth, air, cold and lightning attacks.

Woodland Stride (3rd). Move through natural difficult terrain (thorns, briars, deep snow-choked undergrowth) at full speed, leaving no trail. Magical terrain still hinders you.

Nature Lore (Wisdom). In the Nalwood, identify plants and animals perfectly, tell whether water is safe, and find shelter and food for one person; elsewhere, this frozen country included, it takes a Wisdom check. Feeding more takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds 2d4 more.

Kit: Nalwood Cabal. Forest Vigour: healing you cast restores +1 HP per die. Ancient Lore: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in any old-growth forest.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. With Forest Vigour, your Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+5. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Bramble. A wild boar you keep with Animal Friendship, one of your prepared spells. You renew it each evening before you rest (he makes the Will save each time, and has never wanted to), so the slot is back by morning; harm him and the friendship ends. He follows you and the GM runs him: Level 1, AC 16, 9 HP, speed 40ft, Tusk +4 (1d8+2), Charge (+1d8, and Fortitude DC 12 or Prone, after a 20ft straight run), Relentless once a day.

Elf (Saevren). Speed 35ft, low-light vision. Immune to magical sleep, and Advantage on saves against charm. Trance (4 hours rests you). Keen Senses: Advantage on sight and hearing Perception, and on concentration saves. Advantage on Stealth and Perception in natural surroundings. Camouflage: once a day, as part of your movement in natural terrain, become undetectable to passive notice until you move or act. Weapon training: longbow, shortbow, shortsword, hand axe.

No forged metal. Your weapons and armour are wood, leather and stone, as a druid's must be. You speak Druidic, the circle's secret tongue, and Sylvan, learned in the Nalwood.
